name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
description: An Echoverse warrior who pledged loyalty to Tamiyo and remains her devoted living shield.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo usurps the throne and Yuriko pledges her loyalty.
timeline.quote: When Tamiyo usurped the throne, Yuriko knew her time had come.
